supporting_fact_mapping.paragraph: the sentence list under that title in context
supporting_fact_mapping.evidence_unit: one sentence at sentence_index within that list
identity_notes: Within a question's distractor context, titles are unique (0 duplicate titles observed).
sentence_index is 0-based into the title's sentence list.
1 supporting_fact has out-of-range index (must be handled as gold-resolution error).
Titles are stable enough for Document identity within the distractor setting; not a global Wikipedia dump ID.

explicitly_provided: supporting_facts as unordered-with-respect-to-hops list of (title, sentence_index)
closed distractor context of paragraph titles + sentence lists
must_not_infer: supporting_facts order == Hop-1 → Hop-2 reasoning order
comparison questions are ordered multi-hop chains
every multi-sentence supporting set is an ordered path
multi_hop_structure.comparison_intent: parallel attribute comparison across entities (1487/7405), not an ordered hop chain

A_supporting_fact_recall_at_k.reason: Exact gold (title, sentence_index) set is present; recall = |retrieved ∩ gold| / |gold|.

B_all_supporting_facts_found_at_k.reason: Same gold set; indicator that coverage@K == 1.0.

C_at_least_one_supporting_fact_found_at_.reason: Hit@K over any gold supporting-fact identity.

D_document_recall_at_k.reason: Supporting document titles are exact; every example has exactly 2 supporting titles.

E_ordered_hop1_to_hop2_success.reason: No hop-order field. supporting_facts order is not guaranteed reasoning order; comparison is parallel; 1504/5918 bridge examples begin with two facts from the same document.

distractor_setting.description: Each question ships a closed context list of Wikipedia paragraphs: typically 2 gold + 8 distractors (10 total).
distractor_setting.comparable_to_scifact_notes: SciFact experiments retrieve over a shared abstract corpus. HotpotQA distractor retrieval is over a per-question 2–10 paragraph pool. Results are not directly comparable as global-corpus Hit@K.

recommended_representation.EvidenceUnit: one sentence in that title's sentence list

architecture_fit.notes: Fits existing Document + EvidenceUnit persistence without new tables. CanonicalSection optional later; not required for sentence-level gold.

supporting_facts_do_not_reveal_ordered_h.note: Parallel nationality facts; not Hop-1 then Hop-2.

bridge_with_non_alternating_document_ord.supporting_facts_prefix: three facts from The Hork-Bajir Chronicles before Animorphs facts
bridge_with_non_alternating_document_ord.note: Even for bridge, SF list order is annotation order, not a guaranteed hop sequence.

verdict.label: Suitable only for multi-evidence-set retrieval, not ordered multi-hop retrieval
verdict.rationale: HotpotQA distractor provides exact multi-document supporting-fact golds in a closed context pool (excellent for supporting-fact / document coverage metrics). It does not provide ordered hop-chain labels. Do not evaluate ordered Hop-1→Hop-2 success from supporting_facts order.

recommended_next_step.summary: Implement a read-only HotpotQA distractor → Document + sentence EvidenceUnit materializer and gold resolver, plus metrics A–D (supporting-fact Recall@K, all-found@K, any-found@K, Document Recall@K) on the per-question context pool — no embeddings, no production changes, no ordered-hop metric.
